properties.title: 1818 — Royce Cession 94
properties.description: Land ceded by the Quapaw to the United States under the treaty of August 24, 1818.

properties.title: 1824 — Royce Cession 121
properties.description: The smaller Arkansas tract ceded by the Quapaw to the United States under the treaty of November 15, 1824.

properties.title: 1833 — land assigned to the Quapaw
properties.description: The later tract west of Missouri represented here by Royce 503 and 505 together. This is shown as land assigned to the Quapaw, not as another Quapaw cession.
